kitchen_remodel.title: Kitchen Remodel - Construction Order
kitchen_remodel.content: Professional kitchen renovation time-lapse: demolition → framing → installation → finishing → completion. No duplicate frames.
phases: Demolition (0-3s): Old cabinets and appliances removed
Framing & Utilities (3-6s): Electrical and plumbing rough-in
Cabinet Installation (6-10s): White shaker cabinets and stainless appliances
Countertop & Backsplash (10-13s): Marble island and glass tile
Final Finishes (13-15s): Lighting, hardware, and completion

home_addition.title: Home Addition - Construction Sequence
home_addition.content: Professional 2-story home addition: site prep → foundation → framing → roof → MEP systems → finishing. Every frame unique.
phases: Site Prep (0-3s): Lot preparation and equipment delivery
Foundation & Framing (3-6s): Concrete foundation and wood frame
Roof & Enclosure (6-9s): Roof and windows installation
MEP Systems (9-12s): Electrical, HVAC, and plumbing rough-in
Finish Work (12-15s): Drywall, paint, flooring, trim, final walkthrough
